Visit www.fedex.com/jp > Log in with your fedex.com Login (user ID and password) > Go to ‘Account’ > Select ‘Manage Billing Online’ > Go to the ‘My Options’ tab in the menu bar > Select ‘Update Credit Card’ to enter your Credit Card Information > Click ‘Update Credit Card’ to enter One-Time Password (OTP), if prompted > Click ‘Done’ to complete.

Visit www.fedex.com/jp > Log in with your fedex.com Login (user ID and password) > Go to ‘Account’ > Select ‘My Profile’ > Select ‘Account Management’ > Select ‘View/Edit’ for the account you would like to update > Scroll down to the ‘Credit Card and Billing Information section’ > Click ‘Edit’ to enter your Credit Card Information > Click ‘Save’ after enter One-Time Password (OTP), if prompted > Click ‘Continue’ to complete.

Visit www.fedex.com/jp > Log in with your fedex.com Login (user ID and password) > Go to ‘Shipping’ > Select ‘Billing Details’ > Click on ‘Update the credit card tied to my account’ > Click ‘Edit’ to enter your Credit Card Information > Click ‘Save’ after enter One-Time Password (OTP), if prompted > Click ‘Continue’ to complete.
